faq.title: Happy Horse 1.0 FAQ
faq.description: Questions about the model overview page and how it connects to Happy Horse AI.

items.question: What is Happy Horse 1.0 on this site?
items.answer: Happy Horse 1.0 is the model overview page inside Happy Horse AI. It helps visitors who search for the model name understand which workflows and use cases the platform supports.

items.question: Is Happy Horse 1.0 the same as Happy Horse AI?
items.answer: Not exactly. Happy Horse AI is the platform brand. Happy Horse 1.0 is the model-oriented page that connects model-name searches to the platform workflows.

items.question: Which workflows should I look at next?
items.answer: If you are starting from a prompt, go to text-to-video. If you are starting from an image or references, use image-to-video or reference-to-video. If you already have a clip, use video edit.

items.question: Where should I start if I am new?
items.answer: Most new users should begin on the homepage or the text-to-video page, then move to pricing once they know how often they plan to generate.
